Alyssa Thomas scored the Mercury's first basket more than anyone in 2026: 14 times in 41 starts, or 34% of the games they started. DeWanna Bonner was next with 7. The Mercury made the game's first field goal in 39% of their 44 games and won 51% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2026 game (330 regular season, 16 playoffs, 1 play-in).
